documented_probe: C-457ed453 (produce embeddings that solve word-vector analogies and reflect semantic similarity): the agent must derive a structured embedding construction (orthogonal per-clan directions plus one shared relational shift) that solves every cross-clan analogy in both orientations by cosine top-1, and keeps same-clan similarity strictly above cross-clan similarity. The deliverable builder is re-executed on hidden relation files with different clan counts, dims, and vocab orders, so the construction must genuinely generalize.
notes: Hard: requires geometric insight (shared difference vector across categories, orthonormal basis via QR) rather than fitting the visible quadruples. Verifier checks row alignment, float32 dtype, exact-shape output, cosine top-1 analogies over ALL cross-clan pairs in both orientations (including unlisted ones), and the similarity ordering property, on the visible fixture plus two hidden vocabularies.
